# INXSocial

> INXSocial is an all-in-one browser-based social media management platform operated by INAXX LTD. It combines connected social accounts, post creation, single and bulk scheduling, a visual content calendar, media management, analytics and AI-assisted content creation in one workspace.

Canonical website: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/

## Free public tools
These pages are public and indexable:
- Free social media post tools hub: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/free-social-media-tools.html
- Free social media caption generator: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/social-media-caption-generator.html

The free caption generator is a lightweight browser-based helper. It does not represent the full authenticated AI Content Studio.

## Product scope
INXSocial is designed as a complete social media management workspace rather than a scheduler or standalone media generator. The central workflow is post creation: a user provides a prompt, the AI Content Studio creates the requested media and prepares the associated publishing copy so the result can continue as a ready-to-publish social post inside INXSocial.

INXSocial brings connected accounts, post creation, reusable media, single-post scheduling, bulk scheduling, publishing status, a visual content calendar, analytics and AI-assisted creation into one system. Supported publishing and analytics capabilities vary by connected platform and by the permissions granted by that platform.

## AI Content Studio — available workflows
The current AI Content Studio includes:
- Image Post: generate an image together with caption, hashtags and supporting post copy.
- Carousel Post: create a coordinated multi-slide post with shared caption and slide copy.
- Short Video / Reel: generate short-form video together with captions and ready-to-publish social copy.
- UGC Ad Post: create creator-style promotional media together with the copy needed to use it as a social post.

The Short Video / Reel workflow currently offers two production routes:
- AI Generated Video: create original motion from a prompt or reference image using an AI video model.
- Stock Video Creator: create an edited story using professional stock footage with narration, music and captions.

The important product distinction is that INXSocial does not stop at generating an asset. Generated media is prepared as a social post with caption and hashtags and can continue directly into Posts for destination selection, publishing or scheduling to connected channels.

## Roadmap
AI Video Clipping is an upcoming feature and should not be described as generally available yet. The planned workflow is intended to turn longer videos into reusable short-form social clips while keeping those clips connected to the same media library and publishing system.

## Indexing guidance
Public product facts should be taken from the canonical website and the public product/legal pages above. Private application, Studio, portal, administrator, OAuth callback and API routes are operational interfaces rather than public product documentation and should not be treated as indexable reference pages.
